text_block_list.text:
One day, after winning numerous races
alongside Symboli Rudolf—

I came to the student council room to visit Symboli Rudolf.
The reason was the lottery the two of us had entered earlier.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Whenever you feel the time is right
to embark on our journey, please hand it to me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I wish to entrust it to someone who can evaluate me
fairly and squarely, without overestimating or underestimating me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
“—I see.
So you're saying now is the time.”
choice_data_list: You've done so well to get this far
You've done so well to get this far.

text_block_list.text:
I told her I understand feeling like her ideals are still far away,
but that this is the perfect time to catch her breath.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Understood.
I shall gratefully accept your evaluation.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: In that case, would you mind if I quickly reached out to the other student council members as well?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"They worked hard too.
Since we have the chance, let's make it a staff trip—"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Whatever are you saying? If we stay,
the President herself won't be able to truly rest.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna do whatever I want,
even without you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You two...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Fortunately, the busy season has passed. Leave the rest to us, and please go stretch your wings a bit.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you.
I shall gladly take you up on your kindness this time.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now then... Trainer-kun.
It looks like this will be a leisurely, carefree hot springs trip.
And so, preparations for the trip steadily progressed...
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —Phew... That was refreshing.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
My apologies for keeping you waiting.
Thanks to you, I was able to enjoy the hot spring to my heart's content.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I owe you one.
Still, hot springs really are wonderful, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Amidst the drifting steam, a grand spectacle appears.
After thoughts melt away in the heat, the truth suddenly surfaces.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It was truly time well spent.
...Though I ended up getting a bit dizzy from the bath because of it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I feel perfectly fine.
That said, I'd like to rest a bit before eating.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: How about it, wanna go outside and cool off a bit?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Your cheeks are a little red, too.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes, a pleasant breeze is blowing.
It's perfect for cooling off after a bath...
choice_data_list: What were you thinking about in the hot spring, huh?
What were you thinking about in the hot spring?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The tangible and intangible, all things and affairs.
Trivial matters, useful matters... all sorts of things.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I've just come up with a brilliant pun...
Or maybe not.
choice_data_list: You're zoning out, which is unusual for you.
You seem spaced out, which is unlike you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "Musing while soaking in the bath... that's just how it goes, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yet there is one image
I remember vividly.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—The path I have walked with you
was radiant, even without the moon to light it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hardships certainly accompanied the way,
but even those days are irreplaceable.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"I shall continue to walk with you just the same.
With my gaze firmly fixed upon that radiant, dazzling path..."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I have no intention whatsoever of letting you go.
I look forward to our continued partnership.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Likewise.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... When you put it so formally,
it really is quite embarrassing.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe I'll stay out in the breeze for a little longer.
Even after that, the two of them talked a lot about all kinds of things... from silly little trivialities to genuinely useful topics.

It was a moment where I felt
an irreplaceable bond
with Symboli Rudolf...
